notes.title: (Mechanical Tower 2984) Playtest 1.11 Update Announcement
notes.content: [p][b]New Content[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increase (boss) added "Arrow Shuttle" skill[/p][/*][*][p]Added controller vibration for protagonist's attacks, being hit, and component interactions[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Optimizations[/b][/p][list][*][p]Player dodge speed now increases with movement speed[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized weapon selection display in the "Paradise" scene, now showing the currently equipped weapon type[/p][/*][*][p]Empowerment (boss) will now reclaim its summoned creatures after death[/p][/*][*][p]Bullets from the scatter shot skill of crossbow weapons will now penetrate enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Attack auto-lock will no longer target dead or non-attackable objects[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could pass through the next "door" without defeating all enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Crossbow attacks will now prevent enemies from moving after being hit[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the description of the Command Rod[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Chapter 2 background music could not loop[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where crossbows could kill enemies from a distance without activating combat[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where mouse-click attack direction could be inaccurate in some cases[/p][/*][/list][p]📢 Feedback Channels[/p][p]Community: QQ Group / Discord / X Official Account[/p][p]🌟 To Players: Your feedback helps make [i]Mechanical Tower 2984[/i] better! We look forward to seeing you in the game![/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: Added controller vibration for protagonist's attacks, being hit, and component interactions

tags.balance_change: Player dodge speed now increases with movement speed

tags.feature: Optimized weapon selection display in the "Paradise" scene, now showing the currently equipped weapon type
Empowerment (boss) will now reclaim its summoned creatures after death
Bullets from the scatter shot skill of crossbow weapons will now penetrate enemies

tags.bug: Attack auto-lock will no longer target dead or non-attackable objects
Fixed an issue where players could pass through the next "door" without defeating all enemies

tags.balance_change: Crossbow attacks will now prevent enemies from moving after being hit

tags.bug: Fixed an issue with the description of the Command Rod
Fixed an issue where Chapter 2 background music could not loop
Fixed an issue where crossbows could kill enemies from a distance without activating combat
Fixed an issue where mouse-click attack direction could be inaccurate in some cases
